SELECT AS group_key, AS group_name, SUM(CASE WHEN s.kind = 'SALE' AND s.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sale_count, SUM(CASE WHEN s.kind = 'SALE' AND s.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN s.payable_amount ELSE 0 END) AS sale_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN s.kind = 'RETURN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS return_count, SUM(CASE WHEN s.kind = 'RETURN' THEN s.payable_amount ELSE 0 END) AS return_amount FROM pos_sale s
WHERE 1 = 1 GROUP BY ,
ORDER BY 1

SELECT AS group_key, AS group_name, p.pay_method, SUM(p.amount) AS amount FROM pos_payment p
WHERE p.status = 'SUCCESS' AND p.sale_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY , , p.pay_method
